notes.t: Called Ben the winner; says Ben took advantage of Alex's thin, injured bench and Alex could have covered with a free agent. Likes Golden but thinks Stevenson is pointless.
Tuten has good advanced stats, Golden passes the eye test, and Stevenson will keep a role.
Thumbs-up on Ankit's take.
Likes Golden (about 10 targets a game) and Tuten (clear lead back, few targets); sees it as roughly fair once Stevenson is included.
Said Joe got fleeced and would have landed a fair deal by waiting about six hours.
Pushed back: he had another deal in the works and the player would not have been on his team six hours later.
Quipped that sometimes you have to go backwards to go backwards, a mild dig at Joe's side.
Agreed (facts reaction) with Ankit's quip.
Joked that sometimes you have to go back to go forward, posting a couple of memes.
Thinks Aidan got fleeced in the deal.
Likes it more for Aidan, who also gains freed-up roster spots, though Christian needed to make a move.
Sees it as an even swap of similar value.
Says Joe got fleeced.
Leans Joe got the better end but calls it close and fair.
Said the deal was straightforward: he made an offer and it was accepted.
Called it a fleece by Joe and a gift, saying Ankit got almost nothing back.
Likes the deal for Ankit given the injury timing and the quarterback's likely rebound.
Called it a dead even trade.
Joked off the fleece comment and moved on to other chatter.
Defended buying low on a struggling quarterback.
Said flatly that Steven got fleeced.
Sees a big win for Jake and thinks Steven is now thin at running back and quarterback.
Joked that landing Puka was a golden fleece for Jake.
Called Puka a nutcase who will burn whichever team ends up with him.
Admitted he probably lost it but says his bench backs can step up and he was wary of Bucky's workload.
Hyped the deal as a legacy-swinging move after two contenders chased the same player.
Said Steven got fleeced, swapping for a banged-up back on an offense that just lost its quarterback.
Thought the deal was better for Steven and would rather roster Stevenson despite Monangai's upside.
Joked he liked it better when Alex had no second running back this week.
Called it a decent move for Steven but doubted Stevenson delivers in the playoffs without his quarterback.
Defended the move as zigging against the crowd, citing the starting role, added FAAB and playoff matchups.
Shared a screenshot, cheered with a playful chant, and wondered if it was fair for both sides.
Called it a strong pickup for Aidan and questioned why Ankit did it given his flex depth.
First said it helps Ankit in a must-win week, then backed off after seeing his lineup.
Noted he now has a rare quarterback, receiver and back stack and punned about getting Breece.
